title: Shopify and WhatsApp Integration
seoTitle: Shopify WhatsApp Integration: Order Updates and Carts
seoDescription: Send order confirmations, shipping updates, COD confirmations and abandoned cart reminders from Shopify on WhatsApp. Setup, costs, templates and consent.
summary: A Shopify–WhatsApp integration sends customers order confirmations, shipping updates, COD confirmation requests and abandoned-cart reminders on WhatsApp automatically, using the WhatsApp Business Platform. For Indian D2C brands it typically lifts COD confirmation rates and reduces "where is my order" calls.

dataPoints.label: WhatsApp side
dataPoints.value: WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API) with approved message templates

dataPoints.label: Common messages
dataPoints.value: Order confirmed, COD confirmation, shipped with tracking, delivered, abandoned cart

dataPoints.label: Pricing
dataPoints.value: Meta charges per template message by category (marketing, utility, authentication); utility messages cost less than marketing

dataPoints.label: Consent
dataPoints.value: Customers must opt in to receive WhatsApp messages

body:
## What to automate first

1. **COD confirmation**: ask the customer to confirm before dispatch; cancel unconfirmed orders to cut returns.
2. **Shipping updates** with the tracking link.
3. **Abandoned cart reminders** with a link back to checkout, for customers who opted in.

## Build or use an app

Shopify apps from WhatsApp providers cover standard flows quickly. A custom integration suits you when messages depend on your own logistics, CRM or ERP data. See [WhatsApp Business API](/blog/whatsapp-business-api-automating-customer-communication).

faqs.q: Do I need a new phone number?
faqs.a: The number used for the WhatsApp Business Platform cannot be used on the regular WhatsApp app at the same time, so many brands use a dedicated number.
Yes. Replies arrive in a shared inbox or your CRM, and free-form replies are allowed within the 24-hour customer service window.
